properties.name: ddbid.cron.objects
properties.description: Cron expression for the object dump/import job.

properties.name: ddbid.cron.directmigration
properties.description: Cron expression for the direct migration job.

properties.name: ddbid.cron.retry.delay
properties.description: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds.

properties.name: ddbid.cron.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for scheduled jobs.

properties.name: ddbid.database.file
properties.description: Path to the local H2 database file or a JDBC URL when supported by the selected database type.

properties.name: ddbid.database.query-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Query timeout in seconds for database operations.

properties.name: ddbid.apikey
properties.description: API key for accessing the Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek API.

properties.name: ddbid.database.type
properties.description: Database backend to use. Supported values are h2 and postgres.

properties.name: ddbid.database.url
properties.description: JDBC URL for PostgreSQL, for example jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/ddbid.

properties.name: ddbid.database.user
properties.description: Database user name for PostgreSQL.

properties.name: ddbid.database.password
properties.description: Database password for PostgreSQL.

properties.name: ddbid.database.indexes.auto
properties.description: Create missing database indexes automatically on startup. Disabled by default because H2 locks large tables while indexes are created.

properties.name: ddbid.database.table.item
properties.description: Database table name for items.

properties.name: ddbid.database.table.organization
properties.description: Database table name for organizations.

properties.name: ddbid.database.table.person
properties.description: Database table name for persons.

properties.name: ddbid.statistics.cache.refresh-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for refreshing the daily statistics cache.

properties.name: ddbid.dump.lockfile
properties.description: Path to the lock file used while a dump is running.

properties.name: ddbid.datapath.item
properties.description: Directory for item dump files.

properties.name: ddbid.datapath.organization
properties.description: Directory for organization dump files.

properties.name: ddbid.datapath.person
properties.description: Directory for person dump files.

properties.name: ddbid.security.user
properties.description: HTTP basic authentication user.

properties.name: ddbid.security.password
properties.description: HTTP basic authentication password.

properties.name: ddbid.git.url
properties.description: Git repository URL for migration data.

properties.name: ddbid.git.branch
properties.description: Git branch ref for migration data.

properties.name: ddbid.git.name
properties.description: Git user name for repository access.

properties.name: ddbid.git.pass
properties.description: Git password or token for repository access.

properties.name: scheduler.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable scheduled jobs.
